blocks.text: Computer Network
A computer network is a group of connected computers and devices that share data, resources, and services.
Network Architecture
Network architecture is the design and organisation of a network, including how devices are connected and how communication takes place.
Network Topology
Network topology is the arrangement of devices and connections in a network, such as star, bus, ring, mesh, or tree.
LAN
A Local Area Network (LAN) connects devices within a small area, such as a home, school, office, or computer lab.
WAN
A Wide Area Network (WAN) connects networks over large geographical areas, such as cities, countries, or continents.
Internet
The Internet is the largest public network that connects millions of devices and networks worldwide.
Networking Devices
Networking devices are hardware components, such as switches, routers, modems, NICs, and access points, used to connect devices and manage communication.
OSI Model
The OSI model is a seven-layer model that explains how data travels from one device to another in a network.
Network Protocol
A network protocol is a set of rules that controls how data is sent, received, and understood between devices.
IP Address
An IP address is a unique address assigned to a device so it can be identified on a network.
Subnetting
Subnetting is the process of dividing a large network into smaller networks for better management and security.
Network Security
Network security refers to the methods used to protect networks, devices, and data from unauthorized access, misuse, or attacks.
